text:
Maine aapke case ko human agent ke paas escalate kar diya hai, aur yeh note bhi add kar diya hai ki courier ne galat building (Building B ki jagah Building D) mein deliver kiya hai. 

Ek human agent jaldi hi aapko contact karega aur courier partner se coordination karke iska solution nikalwa dega. Thoda sa samay dein, aapka issue resolve ho jayega.
